name: Miramar Shopping Center
summary: Miramar Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail center in Seabrook, Texas, offering professional services and convenient shopping along Texas 146. The center serves the Clear Lake area community with accessible hours and has earned strong customer ratings.
demographics: Miramar Shopping Center serves the Seabrook, Texas community, a coastal suburb southeast of Houston with a mix of middle to upper-middle income families and professionals working in the nearby aerospace, maritime, and petrochemical industries. The trade area attracts residents from surrounding Clear Lake area communities, including families with children, retirees, and young professionals, with household incomes typically ranging from $60,000 to $120,000. Shoppers in this area tend to value convenience and professional services, seeking financial planning, healthcare, and everyday retail needs close to home.
description: Miramar Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located at 2000-2100 Texas 146 in Seabrook, Texas, serving the Clear Lake area community since its development. This convenient shopping center provides essential services and professional offices to residents of Seabrook and surrounding coastal communities. The center is anchored by Edward Jones financial services, offering comprehensive investment and retirement planning services to local families and business owners. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Miramar Shopping Center provides accessible shopping and services throughout the day. The center has earned a solid 4.2-star rating from nearly 500 reviews, reflecting its role as a trusted community gathering place in this growing Houston-area suburb.
